Name: after
Description:
date format is RFC3339, but can be shortened as required.
i.e. 2011-01-01 is Jan 1 of year 2011 and "2011" means the same.

Name: before
Description:
date format is RFC3339, but can be shortened as required.
i.e. 2011-01-01 is Jan 1 of year 2011 and "2011" means the same.

Name: attr
Description:
match on attribute. Use attr:foo:bar to match nodes having their foo
attribute set to bar or attr:foo:~bar to do a substring
case-insensitive search for 'bar' in attribute foo

Name: childrenof
Description:
Find child permanodes of a parent permanode (or prefix of a parent
permanode): childrenof:sha1-527cf12 Only matches permanodes currently.

Name: parentof
Description:
Find parent permanodes of a child permanode (or prefix of a child
permanode): parentof:sha1-527cf12 Only matches permanodes currently.

Name: format
Description: file's format (or MIME-type) such as jpg, pdf, tiff.

Name: tag
Description: match on a tag

Name: title
Description: match nodes containing substring in their title

Name: ref
Description: match nodes whose blobRef starts with the given substring

Name: camera
Description: Match EXIF camera make or model, case insensitively. Supports '*' at either end, or '~' for substring matching.

Name: is:image
Description: object is an image

Name: height
Description:
use height:min-max to match images having a height of at least min
and at most max. Use height:min- to specify only an underbound and
height:-max to specify only an upperbound.
Exact matches should use height:480

Name: is:landscape
Description: the image has a landscape aspect

Name: is:pano
Description: the image's aspect ratio is over 2 - panorama picture.

Name: is:portrait
Description: the image has a portrait aspect

Name: width
Description:
use width:min-max to match images having a width of at least min
and at most max. Use width:min- to specify only an underbound and
width:-max to specify only an upperbound.
Exact matches should use width:640

Name: filename
Description: Match filename, case sensitively. Supports optional '*' wildcard at beginning, end, or both.

Name: is:post
Description: matches tweets, status updates, blog posts, etc

Name: is:like
Description: matches liked tweets

Name: is:checkin
Description: matches location check-ins (foursquare, etc)

Name: is:bookmark
Description: matches bookmarks (raindrop.io, pinboard, etc)

Name: is:untagged
Description: matches untagged permanodes

Name: is:fitness
Description: matches all fitnessActivity permanodes, including unknown sports and activities without GPS.

Name: is:run
Description: matches fitness activities classified as run.

Name: is:hike
Description: matches fitness activities classified as hike.

Name: is:ride
Description: matches fitness activities classified as ride, including mountain, gravel, virtual, and electric cycling.

Name: is:bike
Description: alias for is:ride; includes all cycling subtypes, including electric bikes.

Name: is:ebike
Description: matches fitness rides whose Strava sport is EBikeRide or EMountainBikeRide; uses legacy stravaActivityType only when stravaSportType is absent or empty.

Name: miles
Description: matches fitness activity distance in miles; use >=5, <=5, >5, <5, =5 or 5, and inclusive ranges 5-10, 5-, -10. Values must be nonnegative finite decimal numbers (scientific notation allowed); miles are 1609.344 meters.

Name: km
Description: matches fitness activity distance in km; use >=5, <=5, >5, <5, =5 or 5, and inclusive ranges 5-10, 5-, -10. Values must be nonnegative finite decimal numbers (scientific notation allowed); miles are 1609.344 meters.

Name: kilometers
Description: alias for km; matches fitness activity distance in kilometers; use >=5, <=5, >5, <5, =5 or 5, and inclusive ranges 5-10, 5-, -10. Values must be nonnegative finite decimal numbers (scientific notation allowed); miles are 1609.344 meters.

Name: meters
Description: matches fitness activity distance in meters; use >=5, <=5, >5, <5, =5 or 5, and inclusive ranges 5-10, 5-, -10. Values must be nonnegative finite decimal numbers (scientific notation allowed); miles are 1609.344 meters.

Name: has:location
Description:
matches images and permanodes that have a location (GPSLatitude
and GPSLongitude can be retrieved from the image's EXIF tags).

Name: loc
Description:
matches images and permanodes having a location near
the specified location.  Locations are resolved using
maps.googleapis.com. For example: loc:"new york, new york"

Name: locrect
Description:
matches images and permanodes having a location within
the specified location area. The area is defined by its
 North-West corner, followed and comma-separated by its
 South-East corner. Each corner is defined by its latitude,
 followed and comma-separated by its longitude.

Name: with
Description: match people containing substring in their first or last name
